posts.text:
The Decision Index scores confidence as well as correctness. A Decision Score runs from 0 (certain and wrong) to 100 (certain and right). Headline metrics such as accuracy ignore confidence and are reported separately. 

On AA-Paperclip, SubQ Snap 1.2 has a Decision Score of 72
